title: Māyāpañcakam
subtitle: Five verses on the power of māyā

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, vol. 16, Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
निरुपमनित्यनिरंशकेऽप्यखण्डे मयि चिति सर्वविकल्पनादिशून्ये ।
घटयति जगदीशजीवभेदं त्वघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: In me, consciousness—unmatched, eternal, partless, undivided, and free of every imagined distinction—māyā brings about a difference between the Lord of the world and the individual soul. Māyā is indeed skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: free of every imagined distinction and the like
skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
nirupamanityaniraṃśake’pyakhaṇḍe mayi citi sarvavikalpanādiśūnye |
ghaṭayati jagadīśajīvabhedaṃ tvaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
श्रुतिशतनिगमान्तशोधकानप्यहह धनादिनिदर्शनेन सद्यः ।
कलुषयति चतुष्पदाद्यभिन्नानघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: Alas, using lures such as wealth, māyā quickly stains even those who investigate hundreds of revealed texts and Upaniṣads, making them no different from beasts and the like. She is skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: the end, or Upaniṣads, of the Vedas
by means of lures such as wealth
skilled at making the impossible happen

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
सुखचिदखण्डविबोधमद्वितीयं वियदनलादिविनिर्मिते नियोज्य ।
भ्रमयति भवसागरे नितान्तं त्वघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: Having placed undivided awareness-bliss, non-dual consciousness, within a world fashioned from space, fire, and the other elements, māyā utterly confuses it in the ocean of becoming. She is indeed skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
sukhacidakhaṇḍavibodhamadvitīyaṃ viyadanalādivinirmite niyojya |
bhramayati bhavasāgare nitāntaṃ tvaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
अपगतगुणवर्णजातिभेदे सुखचिति विप्रविडाद्यहंकृतिं च ।
स्फुटयति सुतदारगेहमोहं त्वघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: In blissful consciousness, beyond distinctions of qualities, color, and birth, māyā makes the ego notion—‘I am a priest, a merchant, and so on’—plainly appear; she also produces attachment to children, spouse, and home. Māyā is indeed skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
apagataguṇavarṇajātibhede sukhaciti vipraviḍādyahaṃkṛtiṃ ca |
sphuṭayati sutadāragehamohaṃ tvaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
विधिहरिहरविभेदमप्यखण्डे बत विरचय्य बुधानपि प्रकामम् ।
भ्रमयति हरिहरभेदभावानघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: Alas, fashioning even the distinction among Brahmā, Hari, and Hara within the undivided, māyā thoroughly bewilders even the wise with the idea that Hari and Hara are separate. Māyā is skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: the notion of a difference between Hari and Hara
skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
vidhihariharavibhedamapyakhaṇḍe bata viracayya budhānapi prakāmam |
bhramayati hariharabhedabhāvānaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Closing colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ मायापञ्चकं संपूर्णम् ॥
units.translation: Thus is completed the Māyāpañcakam composed by the revered Śaṅkara Bhagavat, disciple of the venerable Govinda Bhagavat, the revered teacher who has renounced all, and supreme among wandering ascetics.

gloss.en: whose feet are worthy of worship

units.iast: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau māyāpañcakaṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
